_howto: Add one segment per STABLE posture held. start_s/end_s are seconds into the clip. Leave GAPS between segments for transitions (excluded from scoring). 'posture' must be one of: upright, sitting, in_bed, on_ground.

_postures.upright: standing on your feet / walking (system: UPRIGHT)
_postures.sitting: seated torso-up -- chair or bed edge, feet down (system: SITTING)
_postures.in_bed: on the mattress -- lying or sitting up in bed (system: IN_BED; needs a bed zone)
